text:
sam: eyefall -- p95 and queue length spiked in hosted-usw2 at ~09:12 UTC, looks like a stair-step admission event. dashboards: admission_headroom -> 0.12 then 0.05 then hard throttle :grimacing:
ops-bot: alert posted: GPU_POOL_SATURATION_USW2 (8 nodes > 90% util) :rotating_light:
tanya: seeing same. patterns look like synchronous token-bucket refills across workers after a config reload or rollout. no obvious CPU OOMs.
ben: did a model rollout happen around 09:07? could be traffic shift to heavier variants.
sam: yep we pushed a quantized-8 rollout for embedder at 09:06 that's been ramping. allocation rules routed more sessions to hosted-usw2.
ravi: quick mitigation -> bump admission headroom to reduce immediate drops. doing a safe patch now (will revert after smoothing)
ravi: run: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap admission-config -p '{"data":{"headroom":"0.25"}}'
```
cloud_ops: scaling up 2 GPU nodes in usw2 via internal autoscaler override, ETA ~7m. posting job id `scale-usw2-1723456789`
metrics-bot: queued_reqs: 1200 -> 320 within 3m of headroom patch. p95 latency started dropping back down.
juli: opened PR #2345 to add randomized refill jitter + smoothing window in token-bucket controller. link: https://git.internal/repos/infra/pulls/2345
tanya: we should also add an analytic that emits a refill-coincidence metric (count of refills aligned within 5s across N nodes). will add to dashboards.
sam: follow-up runbook items: 1) when stair-step observed, check recent configmap rollouts, model routing changes. 2) if model rollout correlated, pause and rollback canary. 3) if load spike, bump headroom + temporary capacity.
oben: noted. will coordinate with growth to throttle large bulk jobs if they caused it.
cloud_ops: scale completed, new capacity online. keep monitoring for 10m.
metrics-bot: admission_headroom stabilized at 0.24, queued_reqs steady ~280, admitted_reqs resumed normal rate.
tanya: thanks all — logging action items in the incident tracker and will follow up with dashboard PR. :thumbsup:
